hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: A custom AMM hook managing two pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) that share a single virtual ETH reserve under a constant-product pricing curve. The hook fully intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, minting/burning tokens and settling ETH directly. Applies a 1% buy/sell fee to an immutable treasury address and enforces a 5-block anti-snipe buy cap on launch.
